boundary_evidence.start: The first instruction at $4011AC is AllocFakeRgns. It follows the startup exception module ending at the RTE at $4011AA.
boundary_evidence.end: The final branch at $4017DE returns to MicroBug doReg. The serial ROM debugger begins at $4017E0.

edits.description: Restored the Mac Plus alert manager and MicroBug from StartAlert.a. The evidence records 469 matching released operations and 83 ROM-only operations. Later color icon, variable screen size, NMI flag, and code cleanup changes do not apply to this ROM.

Restored the 58-byte SysBeep body from ROM instructions. The released StartAlert history records its move to OS/Beep.a in June 1986, but that file is absent from the source tree. The routine flashes the menu when sound is active or its volume is zero, otherwise calls BootBeep.

Restored the original BlockMove copies for fake regions, fixed DSAlertRect bounds, stacked error code, VIA mouse polling, and MicroBug port origin. Copied the Mac Plus seRegs definition at $3FFC80 from HardwareEqu.a.
Retained the 10-byte FakeRgn definition and the 34-byte MicroBug command table. The table uses character constants and label differences from the released source.

Retained the released file header, applicable early history, routine descriptions, matching inline comments, and matching body comments. Omitted comments attached to later changes and the reversed FoundObj branch comment.

verification.method: Called the shared verify_module function in an independent temporary directory. It assembled the source, linked at the ROM address, checked entry points and relocations, and compared every emitted byte.
verification.scope: The entire emitted span matches the ROM. MPW assembly has not been run. Byte equality does not establish original formatting or original names for reconstructed labels.
